## Selection checked

The 12 November 2026 review used Philippe's programme filters and 2025 French / Indian Ocean trip selection.

It found 67 trips: 17 observer-monitored and 50 self-reporting, covering 461 sets.

## Useful data

- 1,350 grouped weights, all self-reporting; 1,123 have specified processing and method.
- 4,023 lengths on 4,013 individuals, all observer-monitored; ten turtles have two lengths.
- 1,267 photo references and one tag candidate; their files and meaning still need checking.
- 293 known hook sizes; another 530 are Unknown and two are missing.

## Remaining gaps

This selection has no individual weights, maturity values or mitigation selections.

Missing mitigation selections do not prove that no mitigation was used.

Some data needs interpretation: bait preparation, floatline lengths, sampling protocols and tag events.

Decide whether self-reporting trips belong in the export. Available data does not yet prove complete ROS rows.
